verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's own docs cover every element of the story: Events API dedup_key deduplication, Event Orchestration dedupe/suppress rules, and ML-based Intelligent Alert Grouping that merges related alerts into one incident. Escalation policies then notify a single target at a time until someone acknowledges. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that grouping works in practice, and deeper documentation of grouping configuration and limits (the evidence is only brief doc snippets).

support.subject: As an SRE, duplicate and related alerts are deduplicated and grouped so one incident pages one human, not fifty

citations.quote: Services with Events API integrations deduplicate alerts with matching `dedup_key` values.
Event Orchestration: Automatically deduplicate or suppress alerts.
Intelligent Alert Grouping automatically consolidates related alerts into a single, actionable incident, using machine learning to reduce alert noise for DevOps teams and SREs.
They are designed to notify a single target at a time until one individual acknowledges the incident.
